text:
deploybot: RELEASE 2024.06.1 — hold: SBOM policy triggered for package 'lib-streamer' (transitive dependency 'packetio' v2.3.4) -> license AGPL-3.0. Action required: legal approval or mitigation.

Alice R: saw the bot. can someone paste the offending path?

bob.dev: the SBOM from the CI artifact: `lib-streamer@1.8.0 -> packetio@2.3.4 -> net-transport@0.9`

carol-sec: confirmed. packetio pulled in via runtime-telemetry feature. It's transitive, not direct.

dave-legal: AGPL is high risk for product code. need explicit sign-off from legal to proceed. provide scope of exposure + risk statement.

erin-pm: we have a scheduled canary tonight at 23:00 in the EMEA change window. if we block, feature rollout misses quarter goals.

frank-oncall: quick question — is the vulnerability functional (security) or license-only? can we ship without the telemetry feature?

carol-sec: license-only. no CVE. runtime continues to work. but legal says AGPL requires copyleft — unacceptable for vendor shipping linked code.

bob.dev: technically we can toggle off the runtime-telemetry feature flag at runtime (it's behind FF-telemetry). that would remove import path -> SBOM would not include packetio for the canary artifact if we rebuild without the feature.

Alice R: options: 1) rebuild artifact with telemetry off and proceed 2) pin packetio to a different version/fork (time-consuming) 3) request legal exception (might take >24h) 4) rollback the change out of release (miss window). which is fastest?

carol-sec: 1) rebuild w/o telemetry is quickest. but we need to ensure no regression and update release notes. also must update canary test matrix to confirm telemetry endpoints not hit.

bob.dev: I can prepare a no-telemetry build and smoke it. small code diff: `CONFIG_FEATURES.remove('runtime-telemetry')` in build profile.

Alice R: @bob.dev please do that. frank, can you coordinate canary gating?

frank-oncall: I can hold canary until we have the new artifact. how long to build & smoke?

bob.dev: ~30m to produce build + 30m to run smoke + 15m to push. target delta ~1.5h.

erin-pm: OK if that delays canary by 1.5h. prefer proceeding without legal exception.

dave-legal: if you rebuild without telemetry, we need a short writeup to confirm the released artifact has no dependency on packetio and that the SBOM reflects that. I'll sign the quick risk memo once verified.

carol-sec: add automated SBOM generation step to the smoke checklist: `sbomctl verify --artifact release-2024.06.1-no-telemetry.sbom --assert no:packetio`

bob.dev: copying the exact commands to the thread:
```
# build profile override
export BUILD_FLAGS="--features -runtime-telemetry"
./build/release.sh --profile prod --out artifact-no-telemetry.tar.gz
sbomctl generate artifact-no-telemetry.tar.gz > artifact-no-telemetry.sbom
sbomctl verify artifact-no-telemetry.sbom --assert no:packetio
```

Alice R: good. once sbomctl verify passes, @dave-legal will you sign the quick memo? we need sign-off in thread for compliance audit.

dave-legal: yes — send me the sbom and a one-line business impact. I'll approve an exception for the canary-only release provided packetio is absent and we file a follow-up mitigation plan.

erin-pm: I'll update the release notes to mark telemetry as "disabled for canary due to license remediation in progress" and add a follow-up ticket: PROD-1428 (replace packetio or vendor fork).

frank-oncall: I'll update the change window: canary now at 00:30 UTC instead of 23:00 (pushed +1.5h). logging that in deployment calendar.

bob.dev: build done, smoke started. sbom verify in progress.

deploybot: SBOM verify: artifact-no-telemetry.sbom -> OK (no packetio).

bob.dev: smoke good. pushing artifact to canary bucket.

dave-legal: reviewed sbom + one-line business impact from @erin-pm: "Delay acceptable; telemetry disabled for canary to avoid AGPL exposure while we implement replacement." Approving exception for canary only — document filed: LEGAL-EXC-2024-061.

Alice R: approved by legal and security, canary proceeding at 00:30 UTC. follow-ups: 1) PROD-1428 owner assigned to @bob.dev for dependency replacement 2) add CI check to catch telemetry transitives earlier (carol to own) 3) update release notes and audit doc.

carol-sec: I'll add the CI SBOM gate to the prerelease pipeline and set a policy to fail builds when AGPL-* is present unless approved via LEGAL ticket.

erin-pm: Thanks all. I'll send a short note to stakeholders and add the release note blurb.

Alice R: wrap-up: no rollback, no release-wide block. temporary telemetry disabled for canary, legal exception recorded, replacement path created. closing thread once ticket links are in place. :shipit:
